statement_summary: Maintain a documented security program
Owner designated security officer, recordkeeping contact, and CBP point of contact
Annual risk assessment using SP 800-30
Risk decision rules; High risks never accepted as they are
Annual evaluation with periodic outside review
Annual policy review
Written confidentiality terms for contractors who see client records
Future employees trained first; CBP employee information within 30 days; sanctions
Written, time-limited exceptions
Client records shared only as 111.24 allows, including written client authorization for service providers
Vendor list with records held, location, and terms
Annual review of the customs software vendor SOC 2 report and customer controls
Owner-started, watched remote support; unattended access off
Records stored within the customs territory; storage region recorded
Own accounts; no shared credentials; owner-only customs software and CBP portals
MFA everywhere it is offered; no app passwords or legacy sign-in
Unique passphrases in a password manager; change defaults; change after compromise or departure
Bookkeeper named account with least role; quarterly user review
Device lock after 5 minutes (phone 1 minute)
Sealed recovery codes and emergency sheet with backup broker and records custodian
Monthly review of sign-ins, forwarding rules, and eCBP contact details
Three-level data classification
Restricted data only in approved systems
Full-disk encryption on every device
Keep paper originals until the alternative storage notice; scanning procedure and naming rule
Messaging app documents filed the same day and deleted from the phone
Call-back on a known number before any new or changed payee
Independent versioned backup of the records archive, restored quarterly
Cross-cut shredding; device wipe or certified destruction with a record
Retention schedule with yearly purge and holds
Customs business only within the customs territory
Automatic updates and antivirus stay on
Business Wi-Fi network, not the household network
AI tools only after assessment, no-training terms, and client authorization; owner checks every classification
Annual security course including payment fraud, plus continuing broker education
Incident runbook with printed contacts
Same-day incident log with discovery time
72-hour notice to the CBP Security Operations Center; 10-business-day update
Meet state and client notice deadlines in the P08 matrix
No ransom without counsel and an OFAC check
Backup broker coverage agreement and standby POAs
